newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA'S RESERVE MONEY 4.1 PCT UP IN APRIL.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA'S RESERVE MONEY 4.1 PCT UP IN APRIL.

text.p: The daily average of Romanian reserve money rose by 4.1 percent to 7.0 trillion lei in April after a 14.6 percent increase in March, due to a surge in currency outside banks, central bank (BNR) data showed.
Reserve money, also known as monetary base or high-powered money, includes cash in circulation and in vaults and banks' minimum reserves.
The daily average of cash in circulation went up to 5.3 trillion lei in April from 4.7 trillion in March under the impact of seasonal factors.
Local bankers said the upswing of cash in circulation had been triggered by a wage indexation earlier last month, as well as by bonuses given ahead of the Orthodox Easter.

Banks' minimum reserves slipped to 1.48 trillion lei in April from 1.75 trillion lei in March, taking around 21 percent of the total monetary base, down from about 26 percent the previous month. ($=7,094 lei)
